principles: Consume validated NLU-5 event analysis and NLU-6 event relations; never re-extract or rescore them.
Create exactly one plot node per validated EVT event cluster.
Create plot edges only from admitted NLU-6 temporal/causal relations; never invent narrative-adjacency edges.
Connected components are deterministic weakly connected components over admitted semantic edges; isolated events remain singleton components.
Temporal layers are derived only from temporal.before edges and do not use narrative Passage order as story time.
Do not assign salience, setup, payoff, climax, turning-point, or other narrative-function labels in NLU-7.
Every node and edge remains bound to exact NLU-5/NLU-6 lineage.
Retrieval admission remains closed until a later certified integration.
